what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 3 of 4: The transverse kernel and long-range order for the sphere menu with vacancies. SETTING (the owner's working reading, 2026-09-20; block 39, the open PR titled 'ail39: records that move'): a site is empty or carries ONE record; a record carries its content (six axes); two neighbouring records weigh W = c * omega, omega = p, q, r for equal, opposite, orthogonal axes; a bond with an empty end weighs 1; the axioms' rule K (normalized over contents) does not depend on the scale c. MOTION: a record chooses between its position and an empty neighbouring position in proportion to the pair weights it would have there; this is in detailed balance with the static law on the occupied set. The neutral scale c_0 = 6/(p + q + 4r): an empty neighbour weighs what a record of random content weighs on average, and it is the least scale at which the law with vacancies is reflection positive through bond planes. Simulator: probes/lib/moving_gas.py p q r scale rho L sweeps seed (scale = a number or the word neutral). Block 19 (PR #8153) proved the infrared bound and long-range order for the full-lattice static sphere law by bond-plane reflection positivity; block 39's T5 shows that with an empty state the bond kernel stays positive semidefinite exactly for c >= c_0 = beta/sinh(beta). triage.note: First attempt on this problem. Carries block 19's argument to the law with vacancies: a bond with an empty end weighs 1 whatever the twist, so Gaussian domination runs over occupied-occupied bonds and the infrared bound is <|sigma(k)|^2> <= 1/(beta rho_2 E(k)) with rho_2 the BOND density - beta is replaced by beta rho_2 throughout, which answers (d). The sum rule becomes rho rather than 1 (checked exactly over all 3^9 configurations of a 3x3 torus), giving M^2 >= rho - 3G(0)/(beta rho_2) and LRO once beta rho_2 rho > 3G(0). The binding constraint is rho_2 >= 2 rho - 1, verified sharp by an explicit extremal two-site law, and vacuous at rho <= 1/2, so the explicit threshold beta > 3G(0)/(rho(2 rho - 1)) exists only above half filling and reduces to block 19's 3G(0) at rho = 1. Also recovers c_0 = beta/sinh(beta) as the vanishing of the 2x2 empty/constant determinant, and shows the sphere menu needs no scale-free side conditions because its Bessel coefficients are positive - unlike the six-axis menu. Gaussian domination, Bessel positivity and 3G(0) are ASSUMED; the latter two are same-family.
